title: Work IQ: agents create and edit Office documents
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents Office Document Tools in preview, including supported applications, the creation and editing actions, and the prerequisite to enable Work IQ. The briefing incorrectly calls those details unpublished and leaves the licensing model unknown even though the documented tools use the consumption-billed Work IQ API.
